description: This file defines the `CallServiceAsynch` class, which implements an asynchronous service invocation operation within the MiniLang framework of Apache OFBiz. It provides functionality to execute a specified service asynchronously, with options to include user login and locale information, and handles invocation errors. The class also includes a factory for creating instances based on XML element parsing.

classes.name: CallServiceAsynch
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous service call within the MiniLang framework, allowing non-blocking execution of services with optional inclusion of user login and locale, and handles error scenarios.

classes.name: CallServiceAsynchFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CallServiceAsynch from XML elements.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CallServiceAsynch object by parsing XML element attributes such as service name, input map, and include-user-login flag.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the asynchronous service call, preparing input parameters, optionally adding user login and locale, and invoking the service asynchronously. Handles exceptions and updates the method context accordingly.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the service name used in this operation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of this call operation, mainly for debugging or logging.
